message.content:
Honey is a sweet food that bees make from flower nectar.

## Old honey

Honey found in ancient Egyptian tombs was still edible [#12].

Its low water content helps it keep for a long time.

## Busy bees

Bees visit about two million flowers to make one pound of honey [#13].

This shows how much effort goes into a small jar.
